summary: A mixed day with significant corporate tax developments affecting financial services, regulatory judicial orders on procedural matters, and notable Reliance diversification moves into aerospace and minerals sectors.

bullets.text: IIFL Home Finance faces Rs 963 crore income tax demand; parent IIFL Finance shares drop 8%.
Reliance Industries partners Rolls-Royce to develop India's AMCA engine for military aircraft.
Reliance Industries bids for Odisha bauxite block, signaling entry into aluminium sector.
Delhi HC directs State to decide public prosecutors' challenge to biometric attendance system.
Y Combinator divests 1.05% stake in Meesho for Rs 970 crore at Rs 200 per share.
